target.description: Namespace address of the remote agent, for example alice/researcher@https://relay.example

question.description: Question text. Ask in abstract terms by default; the text goes through the outbound redaction pipeline before delivery.

scopeHint.description: Optional tag-path scopes to draw material from (for example finance/reports). Omit it unless the answer must quote your notes; scopes outside the pre-authorized whitelist fall back to manual review.
